comment: Every part of the Prism answers six questions, after verdant resonance's W5HCertificate (Foundation/Ontology/V1/Model, verifyW5HCertificateComplete) and the six interrogatives of the Zachman framework: what it is, why it is there (the stakeholder concern it answers, through the journey and feature that need it, and what is obstructed without it), who acts in it, where it runs (its boundary), when it acts (its temporal regime) and how it is checked. A part is every tracked module of the page (site/**/*.mjs, site/extension/*.js) and every module of the model (app/src/**/*.lex.tex). tools/parts/gate.py derives each part's answers from the record it already has: the product record's concerns, journeys and features, the coherence registry, the Prism root's dispatch, the imports between parts and the suites and proofs that reach them. Only the strata below are written by hand; each part is grounded in the first stratum whose paths match it, and a part no stratum grounds is refused. A part with an unanswered question is refused unless it is in 'debt', which only shrinks.

agency.means: the Prism deciding on its own
a service or file the owner's content comes from or goes to
the owner, by their own press, words or files
whoever builds the Prism and replays its checks before trusting it

boundaries.means: the Prism's page in the owner's browser
a worker of that page, holding the compiled guests
the Prism's extension in the owner's browser, carrying the page to the owner's services
the proof checker, at build: a model module is checked, never run
a check outside the browser, run on every change

regimes.means: when the Prism is built and checked
when the owner opens the Prism
when content arrives from a source
when the owner presses, writes or asks
on the owner's own periodicities: the day, the week, before what is next

strata.what: a standalone build or fixture that lets a suite run a decision without the page
strata.without: a decision could change without any suite noticing

strata.what: a worker that loads compiled guests and answers the page's requests off the main thread
strata.without: every decision would run on the page's thread and stall what the owner sees

strata.what: a file of the extension, blank until the Prism uses it, that reaches the owner's services where they already are in the browser
strata.without: the Prism could not hear from or speak to the owner's services

strata.what: a reader of what the owner's own browser and device already hold
strata.without: the Prism would ask the owner to configure what the device already knows

strata.what: a reader of one source's content in the shape that source sends it
strata.without: content from that source would not arrive

strata.what: a decision table generated from its specification, the same decisions its guest proves
strata.without: the page could not decide the facet's questions as the model does

strata.what: a specification's own grammar, its rules taken from the pinned standard text by tools/standards/grammar.py
strata.without: the page could not read a message the way its standard defines it

strata.what: a module of the page: what the owner sees and does, and the senses behind it
strata.without: a journey the owner makes would not be there

strata.what: a facet of the Prism's own model: its architecture, design, features, quality, security, compliance, realizability or the browser capabilities it uses
strata.without: a part could be built that no facet of the model defines or holds to account

strata.what: constructive proofs that the modules it imports decide as their specifications say
strata.without: a decision could disagree with its specification unnoticed

strata.what: a compiled decision or model of the Prism, run in its guest
strata.without: the questions it decides would have no answer the owner can trust

concerns.furthest: no check yet orders the work by the journey furthest from its target
